newsitem.title: FINLAND: Merita says 1997 profit outlook unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Merita says 1997 profit outlook unchanged.

text.p: This year has started in line with expectations for Finnish banking group Merita Oy and there is no reason to revise the forecast of somewhat better full-year earnings, Merita president Pertti Voutilainen said on Tuesday.
"It has gone according to plans and if we look at developments on the bourse it has gone even better," Voutilainen told a Reuters reporter on the sidelines of Merita's annual general meeting.
Finnish shares rose strongly early this year. At midday, the HEX all-share index was 16 percent up on the end-1996 level.
"As it looks right now, there is no reason to change what we have said earlier about this year," Voutilainen said, adding: "Earnings will improve somewhat."
Releasing its 1996 results on February 11, Merita said it expected operating earnings to improve clearly this year.
In 1996, Merita posted a 1.20 bilion markka operating profit after credit losses, up from 491 million the previous year. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
